atoms.a: “What do you think causes coasts to change?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>What do you think causes coasts to change</voice>

feedback.end: Waves can be very powerful and are the main reason that coasts change over time.

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>Which two things do you think cause waves</voice>

feedback.end: Storms with strong winds can create large waves that travel for hundreds of miles!

instruction.text: Select the cliffs to learn more about changing coastlines.

feedback.end: These cliffs were created by waves. Big waves hit the cliffs during storms and take away rock. This is called erosion.

instruction.text: Is this statement about beaches true or false?

atoms.a: Beaches can be eroded by waves, just like cliffs.

feedback.correct: The beach on Hurst Spit was once eroded so much that there was a part of the beach missing! People had to replace the shingle to stop the beach being washed away!

instruction.text: We’re back in Ha Long Bay. Select the rocks to find out more.

feedback.end: These rocks are in a sheltered bay, so they are not hit by big waves very often. But they are still eroded slowly by the waves from all of the boats driving past.

instruction.text: Complete these sentences about changing coastlines.

atoms.b: Coastlines change because of powerful ((++waves salt)).
Waves can be caused by wind and ((++boats fish)).
When our cliffs are broken by waves, it is called ((++erosion smashing)).
Beaches ((++can_also cannot)) be eroded by waves.
